cover.alt: The Easee Equalizer announcement film

items.summary: The UK launch film for the Easee Equalizer, a load balancer whose entire value is invisible.
items.overview: The Equalizer is a load balancer. It watches what a home is drawing and shares the available supply between the charger, the heating and everything else, so the car charges as fast as the house can safely allow. This was the film announcing it to the UK market.
items.challenge: You cannot film electricity being balanced. The benefit happens inside a consumer unit, in a house, silently, and the customer only notices it when nothing goes wrong. A UK launch also meant explaining it to two audiences at once: installers who want to know what it does to a load calculation, and homeowners who just want to know why they need it.
